text: **A pair of primitives**: the ⟦MC_15fb340ac8daf4b4_0⟧ primitive and the ⟦MC_ff1e4f0ea496955d_0⟧ primitive. The primitives can be understood as functions we write ourselves, with function names ⟦MC_ec482aacfeeae0bb_0⟧ and ⟦MC_15f28d38c791a58a_0⟧ respectively; the semaphore S in the parentheses is actually a parameter passed in when the function is called.
